title: Saturable nonlinearities in a driven-dissipative bosonic quantum battery
summary: We investigate the charging of a nonlinear quantum battery consisting of a single bosonic mode subject to a saturable nonlinearity, coherent driving, and dissipation. In contrast to Kerr-type anharmonicities, the saturable interaction induces a bounded and nonlinear distortion of the energy spectrum, leading to a progressive increase in the density of energy levels.
